failure.title: Native Card test fixture rendered raw text directly under a View
failure.note: The retained exact fixture reproduces the native renderer rejecting raw Body text below a View after four component checks passed.
failure.diagnosis: The new optional-content fixture passed a bare string to Card even though React Native requires all text nodes below View to be wrapped by Text. Existing production Card callers already satisfied the platform invariant.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
